content.short: Fluid by Instadapp merges lending markets and a DEX so that collateral earns trading fees simultaneously, achieving the highest capital efficiency in DeFi.
content.description: Fluid is the flagship protocol from Instadapp, a team known for building DeFi middleware since 2019, and reimagines capital efficiency by merging lending markets with a DEX in a single unified protocol. Collateral deposited into Fluid's money market simultaneously serves as liquidity in DEX pools, allowing users to earn trading fees on their collateral while borrowing against it  effectively doubling the utility of every deposited asset. Fluid is available on Mantle, bringing this breakthrough capital efficiency architecture to the network's DeFi users.
content.meta: Fluid by Instadapp combines money markets and DEX for maximum capital efficiency on Mantle. Discover Fluid on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
